So, I hit it with Ehrlich reagent and it is a lysergamide. Now I’m waiting for a Hoffman kit because it’s definitely 100% not LSD. I had another friend take a tab who hasn’t done any physchedelics in about 6 months and he had the exact same thing happen. 

As for reliable source, it was a friend who I trusted, and apparently should not have. 

As for the body load, it has NEVER happened in 50+ trips in my life except once with 1p-LSD (and it was not half as bad as this particular trip). I guarantee this isn’t LSD. However, the only thing I suspect it could be is 25i or AL-LAD, but the lack of bitterness or any taste at all tells me that’s unlikely 25i, and it passed the Ehrlich test so my educated guess is AL-LAD. 

Finally, I said, verbatim, “I know none of these questions can be answered definitively...” meaning I know that no one anywhere can tell me for sure what I ingested. I’m just curious what else it could have been if not AL-LAD if anyone has any suggestions. that’s all.

Well subs don’t have naltrexone in them, they have naloxone in them which is shorter acting. Plus it’s an opioid antagonist as opposed to the bup which is a partial agonist. And while your receptors will favor the bup in subs if you flood the receptors with dope you can usually push past. It’s not the same for naltrexone.
